message: I remember one time when the power went out unexpectedly. Instead of panicking, I grabbed my trusty flashlight and some cozy blankets, set up a little fort in the living room, and made it a family movie night with snacks from the fridge. It turned into a fun adventure, and we ended up laughing more than we would have on a regular evening. It’s a great reminder that even in unexpected moments, we can create warmth and joy. How do you make the best of a blackout?
